Subject: ClearWave multi-year renewal guard request (CW-512) - exec approval needed

Team,

Summary: ClearWave (prospect -> strategic win) is asking for a 3-year commercial package with a price-lock and an uplift cap. Key ask:
- Price lock at current rates for 36 months
- Uplift cap: not to exceed 7% per year
- Renewal protection clause: no automatic increase >10% at renewal, 60-day notice requirement
- One-time onboarding credit of $45k (applied in year 1)

Why this matters: ClearWave is a fast-growing healthcare data integrator; closing a flagship multi-year deal would give us a marquee reference in the payer space and justify a longer-term dedicated capacity conversation. Their procurement team has signaled urgency to finalize terms before the end of Q3 to align budget cycles.

Economics (high level):
- Year 1 ARR (net of credit): $625,000
- Year 2 ARR (baseline): $730,000
- Year 3 ARR (baseline): $780,000
- Approx. blended ARR across 3 years: ~$711,000
- Estimated margin impact vs. standard pricing: ~11% (year 1 with credit), ~6% thereafter

Policy deviation: This request exceeds the typical 24-month price-lock limit and asks for a <10% uplift cap. It also requests a renewal protection clause atypical for our standard terms.

Ask: I need an executive approval to proceed with the documented terms (or a counter proposal). Please respond with APPROVE / APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS / DECLINE and list any required conditions. Timing: ClearWave expects a signed term sheet by 2027-07-07.

Attachments (for review): ClearWave_SOW_v3.pdf; Pricing_Schedule_CW-512.xlsx; Redlines_CW.pdf

Chloe Martin
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com

Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:15:02 -0700
Subject: Re: ClearWave multi-year renewal guard request (CW-512) - exec approval needed

Chloe / team,

Deal desk take (short): Recommend APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS. I ran the numbers and spoke with Legal briefly. Rationale and proposed guardrails below.

Recommended conditions:
- Approve 36-month term but shift uplift cap to 10%/year (flooring language: any increase must be >= CPI or 10%, whichever is lower)
- Include an annual usage true-up clause (customer pays for overages each 12-month anniversary)
- Onboarding credit of $45k to be amortized over 12 months for revenue recognition
- Add performance SLA clause tied to a service credit (1% ARR credit if monthly availability < SLA) to protect the company from open-ended commitments
- Approval contingent on Legal sign-off for redlines (see attached Redlines_CW.pdf)
- Finance (Markus) to confirm revenue recognition approach and confirm whether credit needs to be withheld from NRR calculations for quota crediting

Impact: Approving with these conditions keeps the commercial upside (strategic logo, expansion potential) while limiting long-term unit economics risk. Expected margin recovery in year 2+ assuming usage growth.

Requested next steps: Laura to sign-off on the executive condition list. If Laura approves, Marissa / Legal will finalize language and push DocuSign to the customer.

Attachments referenced: Pricing_Schedule_CW-512.xlsx (detailed tiers), Redlines_CW.pdf (legal redline summary)

--
Marissa Cole
Deal Desk Manager, Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 14:25:47 -0700
Subject: Re: ClearWave multi-year renewal guard request (CW-512) - exec approval needed

Thanks for the clear analysis, Marissa.

Decision: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS (as summarized below). I'm comfortable authorizing the terms given the strategic value and the mitigations in place, provided Legal and Finance satisfy the outstanding items.

Conditions to be satisfied before signature:
1) Legal to accept the redlines in Redlines_CW.pdf or provide alternative limited language; no open indemnities beyond our standard language.
2) Renewal protection must include a 60-day notice, and allow us to increase price by up to 10% at renewal (not to exceed CPI + 5% if CPI spikes) — this closes the open-ended risk.
3) Add a performance SLA with explicit service credits (as Marissa recommended).
4) Markus to confirm revenue recognition treatment of the onboarding credit and any effects on bookings quotas.

Markus: please confirm revenue recognition approach by end of day tomorrow. If Finance or Legal raises hard objections, pull me back in immediately.

Approved for signature once Legal and Finance confirm. Laura

Laura Bennett
VP, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

Summary of executive decision (approved with conditions):
- Term: 36 months (price locked for full term)

- Renewal protection: vendor may increase price up to 10% at renewal; 60-day notice required (we will not do open-ended unlimited increases)
- Onboarding credit: $45,000 (amortized over 12 months in our contracts)
- Annual usage true-up to reconcile overages
- Performance SLA added with service credits tied to availability

Next steps:
1) Legal will circulate a final redline and DocuSign envelope by end of week — link will be provided.

3) Sign once Legal returns the final DocuSign packet (target: 2027-07-07 to align with your procurement timeline).
